  "response_format": { "type": "json_object" },

" + {{ JSON.stringify($json.project) }} + "

Flags détectés: " + {{ JSON.stringify($json.flags) }} + "

parameters.jsCode:
const llm = $json; let r = {};
try { const c = llm.choices && llm.choices[0] && llm.choices[0].message && llm.choices[0].message.content; if (c) r = JSON.parse(c); } catch(e){ r = {}; }
const ctx = $('Boucle (1 par 1)').first().json;
const project = ctx.project || {};
return [{ json: {
  id: 'bcl_' + Date.now() + '_pd',
  ts: new Date().toISOString(),
  run_id: 'pd_' + Date.now(),
  source_workflow: 'WF11',
  item_type: 'project',
  item_id: project.id,
  title: 'Risque projet — ' + (project.client_name || project.id),
  recommendation: r.recommendation || ('Flags: ' + (ctx.flags||[]).join(',')),
  recommended_action: r.recommended_action || 'status_check',
  priority_score: '',
  priority_level: ctx.risk === 'critical' ? 'critical' : (ctx.risk === 'high' ? 'high' : 'medium'),
  expected_impact: 'high',
  effort_level: 'medium',
  assigned_to: r.owner_suggestion || 'Arsène+Kentin',
  requires_human_validation: 'true',
  decision_status: 'pending',
  decided_by: '',
  decided_at: '',
  notes: 'flags=' + (ctx.flags||[]).join(',') + (r.client_message_draft ? ' | client_draft: ' + r.client_message_draft : '')
}}];
